arxiv-2102-11782.title: Parameterized Complexity of Logic-Based Argumentation in Schaefer’s Framework
arxiv-2102-11782.creator: Yasir Mahmood, Arne Meier, Johannes Schmidt
arxiv-2102-11782.description: Abstract Logic-based argumentation is a well-established formalism modelling nonmonotonic reasoning. It has been playing a major role in AI for decades, now. Informally, a set of formulas is the support for a given claim if it is consistent, subset-minimal, and implies the claim. In such a case, the pair of the support and the claim together is called an argument.

arxiv-2103-17028.title: Digital Forensics vs. Anti-Digital Forensics: Techniques, Limitations and Recommendations
arxiv-2103-17028.creator: Jean-Paul A. Yaacoub, Hassan N. Noura, Ola Salman, Ali Chehab
arxiv-2103-17028.description: Abstract The number of cyber attacks has increased tremendously in the last few years. This resulted into both human and financial losses at the individual and organization levels. Recently, cyber-criminals are leveraging new skills and capabilities by employing anti-forensics activities, techniques and tools to cover their tracks and evade any possible detection.

arxiv-2110-13860.title: q q -Heun equation and initial-value space of q q -Painlevé equation
arxiv-2110-13860.creator: Shoko Sasaki, Shun Takagi, Kouichi Takemura
arxiv-2110-13860.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shoko Sasaki, Shun Takagi, Kouichi Takemura. We show that the q q -Heun equation and its variants appear in the linear q q -difference equations associated to some q q -Painlevé equations by considering the blow-up associated to their initial-value spaces. We obtain the firstly degenerated Ruijsenaars-van Diejen operator from the linear q q -difference equation associated to the q q -Painlevé equation of type E 8 E_{8} . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

As the indistinguishable patterns between near-end speech and interference signals, near-end speech can’t be separated completely, causing speech distortion and interference signals residual. arxiv-2312-14641.title: Can we observe effects of early nonequilibrium dynamics using collective flow
arxiv-2312-14641.creator: \firstname Piotr \lastname Bożek \fnsep
arxiv-2312-14641.description: Abstract The rapid expansion of the fireball created in a heavy-ion collision causes strong departures from local equilibrium. Such effects are especially important in the very early phase of the collision, bringing a substantial pressure asymmetry. We investigate effects of this early stage pressure asymmetry in a kinetic model without boost-invariance.

arxiv-2402-01782.title: Benchmarking Spiking Neural Network Learning Methods with Varying Locality
arxiv-2402-01782.creator: Jiaqi Lin, Sen Lu, Malyaban Bal, Abhronil Sengupta
arxiv-2402-01782.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), providing more realistic neuronal dynamics, have shown to achieve performance comparable to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) in several machine learning tasks. Information is processed as spikes within SNNs in an event-based mechanism that significantly reduces energy consumption. However, training SNNs is challenging due to the non-differentiable nature of the spiking mechanism.

arxiv-2403-17641.title: A Dominance Argument Against Incompleteness
arxiv-2403-17641.creator: Christian Tarsney, Harvey Lederman, Dean Spears
arxiv-2403-17641.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christian Tarsney, Harvey Lederman, Dean Spears. This article presents a new argument against many forms of moral and prudential value incompleteness. The argument relies on two central principles: (i) a weak “negative dominance” principle, to the effect that Lottery 1 is better than Lottery 2 only if some possible outcome of Lottery 1 is better than some possible outcome of Lottery 2, and (ii) a weak form of ex ante Pareto, to the effect that, if Lottery 1 gives an unambiguously better (stochastically dominant)

arxiv-2405-02054.title: An analogue of the Milnor conjecture for the de Rham-Witt complex in characteristic 2
arxiv-2405-02054.description: Abstract We describe the modulo 2 2 de Rham-Witt complex of a field of characteristic 2 2 , in terms of the powers of the augmentation ideal of the ℤ / 2 \Z/2 -geometric fixed points of real topological restriction homology TRR \TRR .

arxiv-2502-17212.title: A Tractable Two-Step Linear Mixing Model Solved with Second-Order Optimization for Spectral Unmixing under Variability
arxiv-2502-17212.creator: Xander Haijen, Bikram Koirala, Xuanwen Tao, Paul Scheunders
arxiv-2502-17212.description: Abstract Spectral unmixing is an important task in hyperspectral image processing. It can be thought of as a regression problem, where the observed variable (i.e., an image pixel) is to be found as a function of the response variables (i.e., the pure materials in a scene, called endmembers).

arxiv-2504-07967.description: Abstract Channel models that represent various operating conditions a communication system might experience are important for design and standardization of any communication system. While statistical channel models have long dominated this space, ml ( ml ) is becoming a popular alternative approach. However, existing approaches have mostly focused on predictive solutions to match instantaneous channel realizations.

arxiv-2507-17253.title: Optimizing Delivery Logistics: Enhancing Speed and Safety with Drone Technology
arxiv-2507-17253.creator: Maharshi Shastri, Ujjval Shrivastav
arxiv-2507-17253.description: Abstract The increasing demand for fast and cost-effective last-mile delivery solutions has catalyzed significant advancements in drone-based logistics. This research describes the development of an AI-integrated drone delivery system, focusing on route optimization, object detection, secure package handling, and real- time tracking.

arxiv-2508-09781.title: Condition number for finite element discretisation of nonlocal PDE systems with applications to biology
arxiv-2508-09781.creator: Olusegun E. Adebayo, Raluca Eftimie, Dumitru Trucu
arxiv-2508-09781.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the condition number for a system of coupled non-local reaction-diffusion-advection equations developed in the context of modelling normal and abnormal wound healing. Following a finite element discretisation of the coupled non-local system, we establish bounds for this condition number. We further discuss how model parameter choices affect the conditioning of the system.

plos-pone-0010184.title: β-Catenin Phosphorylated at Serine 45 Is Spatially Uncoupled from β-Catenin Phosphorylated in the GSK3 Domain: Implications for Signaling
plos-pone-0010184.creator: Meghan T. Maher, Rigen Mo, Annette S. Flozak et al.
plos-pone-0010184.description: PLOS ONE research article. C. elegans and Drosophila generate distinct signaling and adhesive forms of β-catenin at the level of gene expression. Whether vertebrates, which rely on a single β-catenin gene, generate unique adhesive and signaling forms at the level of protein modification remains unresolved.

pmc-11377473.title: Calcium Pyrophosphate Crystal Formation and Deposition: Where Do we Stand and What Does the Future hold?
pmc-11377473.creator: Silvia Sirotti, Anna Scanu, Tristan Pascart, Tom Niessink, Paola Maroni, Giovanni Lombardi, Georgios Filippou
pmc-11377473.description: Purpose of the reviewAlthough calcium pyrophosphate deposition (CPPD) has been known since the 1960s, our understanding of its pathogenesis remains rudimentary. This review aims to illustrate the known mechanisms underlying calcium pyrophosphate (CPP) crystal formation and deposition and explore future directions in research.

pmc-11664441.title: Pseudo-Sciatica Pain Due to a Biceps Femoris Muscle Tear
pmc-11664441.creator: Rodrigo Correia, Guilherme Correia, Sofia Meixedo, Miguel de Castro Correia, José Luís Carvalho
pmc-11664441.description: Hamstring injuries (HSIs) are common among athletes, particularly in high-speed sports, and are frequently associated with prolonged recovery periods and a high recurrence rate. This study presents a 36-year-old male with sciatica-like symptoms following an acute hamstring tear during an amateur football match. The patient experienced this pain two weeks after the injury, suggesting potential sciatic nerve involvement.

pmc-11688025.title: Causal relationship between gut microbiota and androgenetic alopecia: A Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11688025.creator: Jinyue Liu, Wenrong Luo, Zheyuan Hu, Xiaohai Zhu, Lie Zhu
pmc-11688025.description: Recent studies have found a strong correlation between gut microbiota and the risk of skin diseases and proposed a “gut-skin axis.” Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is the most common type of alopecia, and androgen plays an important role in its pathogenesis.

pmc-12648097.title: Research progress on generation, detection and control of hazards in baked foods during thermal processing
pmc-12648097.creator: Qi Zhang, Pei Liu, Yanhong Ma, Yuhua Diao, Ying Gu, Xuejing Fan
pmc-12648097.description: Thermal processing techniques, such as baking, play a crucial role in imparting desired sensory characteristics to food. However, these processes simultaneously lead to the formation of various thermal processing hazards (TPHs), including acrylamide (AA), 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (5-HMF), furan, advanced glycation end products (AGEs), heterocyclic amines (HCAs), and imidazoles (MI).

pmc-12894546.title: Investigating the Structure of Emotion: Tools, Pitfalls and Recommendations
pmc-12894546.creator: Chujun Lin, Yanting Han, Umit Keles, Yue Xu, Junsong Lu, Ruoying Zheng, Ralph Adolphs
pmc-12894546.description: People use hundreds of words to describe emotions and related mental states. Yet a large psychological literature and our own intuition argue for a simpler structure that underlies these attributions, since most of the words are antonyms or synonyms that map onto a few basic dimensions or categories.

pmc-13252994.title: From Preservation to Repair: A Systematic Review of Therapeutic Organ Rehabilitation During Normothermic Ex Vivo Machine Perfusion
pmc-13252994.creator: Syed Sikandar Raza, Caitlin M. Bocks, Spencer G. Amacher, Kristopher B. Deatrick, Yuliya Tipograf, Alvaro Rojas-Peña
pmc-13252994.description: Background.Normothermic ex vivo machine perfusion (NMP) enables active organ rehabilitation rather than passive preservation. While lung perfusion represents the most mature therapeutic paradigm, kidney, liver, and heart applications are emerging. This review examines therapeutic interventions during NMP across these organs to identify shared mechanisms and translational gaps.Methods.

pmc-13542271.title: Non-invasive characterization of perivascular subarachnoid spaces
pmc-13542271.creator: Nina E. Fultz, Geir Ringstad, Madda Debiasi, Emiel C. A. Roefs, Siri Fløgstad Svensson, Per Kristian Eide, Marianne A. A. van Walderveen, Jeroen de Bresser, Matthias J. P. van Osch, Lydiane Hirschler
pmc-13542271.description: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is thought to facilitate brain waste clearance and immune surveillance, yet its compartmentalization remains unclear. Previous work, using invasive dynamic intrathecal MRI contrast imaging, identified a perivascular subarachnoid space (PVSAS) that enhances along the major cerebral arteries with a ‘donut’-like appearance.

pmc-13592414.title: Broadband and Enhanced Second‐Harmonic Generation in Metallic 3R‐TaS2
pmc-13592414.creator: Ruo‐Si Chen, Chuanyu Wang, Xiangqi Liu, Zhuoyuan Lu, Shuyao Qiu, Boqing Liu, Tieyu Lü, Shi‐Rui Zhang, Yanfeng Guo, Yuerui Lu
pmc-13592414.description: Second‐harmonic generation (SHG) serves as a fundamental mechanism for frequency conversion and light manipulation in photonic devices, as well as a powerful probe for exploring nonlinear optical properties in 2D materials. However, in metallic 2D systems, strong free‐carrier absorption and shallow optical penetration depth usually suppress the nonlinear response.

pmc-13638091.title: 3D Liquid Crystal Framework Enclosing Dual Compartments
pmc-13638091.creator: Yang‐yang Zhao, Huan‐jun Lu, Helgard Ebert, Xiang‐bing Zeng, Chunlan Ma, Feng Liu, Carsten Tschierske, Goran Ungar
pmc-13638091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We report a new 3D‐ordered liquid‐crystal (LC) phase where alkyl and fluoroalkyl side‐chains are confined within separate stretched octahedral cages of a tetragonal framework with struts of aromatic rods held together by their hydrogen‐bonded ends acting as flexible hinges. This is the first example of a multicolor micellar LC heralding the development of soft and dynamic dual‐compartment frameworks, also capable of a martensitic‐type phase transition.

pmc-5520850.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). Extensive pre-mRNA back-splicing generates numerous circular RNAs (circRNAs) in human transcriptome.
